name: Wironggo Vercaemer
bio: Wironggo Alberic Vercaemer (often known simply as Ronggo Vercaemer) is a rising Indonesian athlete, fashion model, and actor who gained widespread viral popularity on social media. Born on October 31, 2007, in Yogyakarta, he is widely recognized for his unique background: he is of mixed Belgian and Javanese descent and famously surprises fans by speaking in a highly fluent, local Javanese (medok) accent.
